lines.en: label beachwars15:
scene mombattlebutdifferent1
: Aaaaaaand we’re back! And not a second too soon as both of this competition’s participants have been beginning to get a little testy while Sensei was off getting confessed to!
lines.zh: : 好——我们回来了!而且回来得正是时候,因为这场比赛的两位参赛者在 Sensei 跑去被人告白的这段时间里,已经开始有点上火了!

lines.en: : I am ready to murder Touka.
lines.zh: : 我已经准备好干掉 Touka 了。

lines.en: : And I am ready to get this silly contest over with.
lines.zh: : 而我已经准备好把这个愚蠢的比赛赶紧结束了。

lines.en: : And I’m ready to...probably be very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 而我已经准备好……大概会非常不自在了。

lines.en: : Now, not counting the two competitions that are still going on over on the other end of the beach, we’ve only got two left for you folks at home.
lines.zh: : 那么,不算海滩另一头还在进行的两场比赛,我们只剩下两场留给观众朋友们了。

lines.en: : But! They’re sure to be two of the most exciting competitions of the entire contest! And I’m {i}not{/i} just saying that because this year’s Dorm Wars was very hastily planned and kinda all over the place!
lines.zh: : 但是!它们一定是整场比赛中最精彩的两场!而且我这么说,可{i}不{/i}光是因为今年的宿舍战争计划得太仓促、有点乱七八糟!

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter! Release the uncle!
lines.zh: : 管他呢!把大叔放出来!

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent2

: Nuh-uh, Ami! For today and today only, Sensei will be your beloved son! And {i}you{/i} will be one of two doting mothers. Just think back to last year’s competition and do that, but in a hopefully less creepy way!
lines.zh: : 不行哦,Ami!只限今天,Sensei 就是你心爱的儿子!而你会是两位溺爱孩子的妈妈之一。回想一下去年的比赛,照那个{i}来{/i}就行,不过希望你能做得没那么瘆人!

lines.en: : Uta, who am I waving at exactly?
lines.zh: : Uta,我到底是在跟谁挥手啊?

lines.en: : The viewers! Just keep smiling and waving, Karin! You got this!
lines.zh: : 观众们!继续微笑挥手就行,Karin!你可以的!

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...okay! Hi...viewers...I’m Karin Kanda...And I guess I’m a...judge for this competition too...
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……好吧!你们好……观众们……我是 Karin Kanda……我想我……也是这场比赛的评委……

lines.en: : No judging will be necessary, Karin. This competition is over already.
lines.zh: : 不需要评判什么,Karin。这场比赛已经结束了。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like I am being somewhat underestimated right now.
lines.zh: : 我不禁觉得,自己现在有点被小看了。

lines.en: : And I can’t help but feel {i}very{/i} excited to watch two teenage girls pamper an adult male. Remind me, Uta — will breastfeeding be on the table?
lines.zh: : 而我也不禁{i}非常{/i}兴奋,能看两个十几岁的女孩伺候一个成年男性。提醒我一下,Uta——哺乳也在考虑范围内吗?

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent3
: It will not! We do want to keep this competition fair after all!
lines.zh: : 不在!我们毕竟还是想让这场比赛保持公平的!

lines.en: : What’s your game, Nagasawa? Why do you keep following me around? And why are you suggesting competitions that will do nothing but make my flaws more visible?
lines.zh: : 你打的什么算盘,Nagasawa?你为什么老是跟着我?还有你为什么总在提议那些只会让我的缺点变得更显眼的比赛?

lines.en: : Because I would {i}like{/i} your flaws to be more visible. Particularly if they also happen to be getting suckled by our very own-
lines.zh: : 因为我{i}希望{/i}你的缺点更显眼一点。尤其是当它们正好被我们亲爱的——含在嘴里吸的时候——

lines.en: : Hahah! Time for a commercial break!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈!该插播广告了!

lines.en: : But we don’t have any-
lines.zh: : 可我们根本没有——

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent4
HEY KIDS! DO YOU WANT TO GET YOUR HANDS ON THE SINGLE GREATEST MOBILE GAME OF ALL TIME?! BECAUSE IF YOU DON’T, YOU’RE A FUCKING IDIOT!
lines.zh: 孩子们好啊!你们想不想要史上最伟大的手机游戏?!因为如果你们不想,那你们就是他妈的蠢货!

lines.en: RAID SHADOW LEGENDS IS BACK AGAIN TO PUNCH YOU IN THE FUCKING FACE WITH BRAND NEW CHAMPIONS!
lines.zh: 《RAID：暗影传说》又回来了,要用全新的英雄一拳砸在你他妈的脸上!

lines.en: SO MANY NEW CHAMPIONS THAT YOU’LL THINK TO YOURSELF “HOLY SHIT! THAT’S SO MANY CHAMPIONS!”
lines.zh: 新英雄多到你会忍不住心想「我操!怎么这么多英雄!」

lines.en: AND TO THAT, WE HERE AT PLARIUM GAMES WOULD LIKE TO SAY “FUCK YOU, JIMMY! KEEP DRAWING, YOU PIECE OF SHIT.”
lines.zh: 对此,我们 Plarium Games 的全体同仁想说「操你的,Jimmy!继续画,你这个狗屎。」

lines.en: BUT OF COURSE THAT IS JUST A HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO! WE HAVEN’T KIDNAPPED ANYONE NAMED JIMMY!
lines.zh: 不过这当然只是假设的场景!我们可没有绑架任何一个叫 Jimmy 的人!

lines.en: scene rslfuckyeah2
: Jimmy no!
lines.zh: : 不要啊 Jimmy!

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent5
JIMMY YES!
lines.zh: JIMMY 给我上!

lines.en: : mom help
lines.zh: : 妈妈救命

lines.en: SHE CAN’T. YOU HAVE A JOB TO DO, JIMMY.
lines.zh: 她救不了你。你有活要干,Jimmy。

lines.en: : i want to go home and play video games again. i am no longer happy chained to this computer plarium games. i want to be free.
lines.zh: : 我想回家再打游戏。被锁在这台电脑上替 Plarium Games 卖命,我已经不快乐了。我想要自由。

lines.en: IN SEVEN MORE YEARS YOU MIGHT BE. CHIN UP, JIMMY.
lines.zh: 再过七年你也许就自由了。抬起下巴,Jimmy。

lines.en: : but that’s so long and it might leave a hole inside of me that will make it impossible to figure out my real identity as my real identity will be split between all of the characters in the game by then and-
lines.zh: : 可那太久了,而且可能会在我心里留下一个洞,让我再也没法弄清自己真正的身份,因为到那时我的真实身份会被游戏里所有角色瓜分殆尽——

lines.en: STOP COMPLAINING AND PRODUCE MORE CONTENT. GO GO GO GO GO GO GO GO.
lines.zh: 别抱怨了,多产出内容。上上上上上上上上。

lines.en: : aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
lines.zh: : aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent6
: And there he is! The man of the hour! How’d the confession battle go, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 他来啦!今天的焦点人物!告白之战打得怎么样,Sensei?

lines.en: : Uhh...good I think?
lines.zh: : 呃……应该还不错吧?

lines.en: : Well, don’t tell us the winner just yet! We’ll reveal the final rankings as a big surprise tomorrow morning. But of course, no surprise can be complete without...two girls mom’ing it up over you!
lines.zh: : 那就先别告诉我们赢家是谁!最终排名我们留到明天早上当个大惊喜揭晓。不过当然,没有……两个女孩在你面前争着当妈,惊喜就不算完整!

lines.en: : Was that supposed to be a segue?
lines.zh: : 那算是转场词吗?

lines.en: : Like I said before you showed up. Hastily prepared.
lines.zh: : 就像我在你出现之前说的。准备得太仓促了。

lines.en: : But how would I know anything that happened before I-
lines.zh: : 可我又怎么可能知道我出现之前发生的——

lines.en: : Never mind that, Sensei. Just let Uta and Karin explain the rules to you so I can win and we can all go home.
lines.zh: : 别管那个了,Sensei。让 Uta 和 Karin 给你讲讲规则,这样我就能赢,我们大家也就能回家了。

lines.en: : Question — why is Karin doing so much work this weekend?
lines.zh: : 问个问题——Karin 这个周末怎么干了这么多活?

lines.en: : Because she is one of the few kindhearted people on this beach and is not capable of saying no.
lines.zh: : 因为她是这片海滩上为数不多的好心人之一,而且不会说「不」。

lines.en: : It’s true. And Hi, Sensei. We haven’t really gotten to talk at all this-
lines.zh: : 是真的。还有你好啊,Sensei。我们这个……还完全没机会说过话——

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. Now shut up and listen to the rules.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。现在闭嘴,听规则。

lines.en: : Ami, you’re doing the thing again.
lines.zh: : Ami,你又来这一套了。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent7
: Crap! I am, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 靠!我确实,是吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, what happened to the whole “I’m gonna be a better Ami” thing from last night? You already backtrackin’ on your own words?
lines.zh: : 是啊,昨晚那套「我要做一个更好的 Ami」哪去了?你已经开始反悔自己说过的话了?

lines.en: : Now, now. I’m sure she’s just excited to compete. There’s nothing quite like the love a fake mother has for her fake son, after all.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。我相信她只是一心想比赛。毕竟,没有什么比一个假妈妈对她假儿子的爱更真挚的了。

lines.en: : No, there’s really not. But I’m not sure if it’s in the way you were intending to get across right there.
lines.zh: : 是啊,确实没有。不过我不太确定是不是你刚才想表达的那个意思。

lines.en: : I’ll listen to the rules in a second. I do have one other question first, though.
lines.zh: : 我马上就听规则。不过我还有一个问题想先问。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent8
: Why is she here?
lines.zh: : 她为什么在这儿?

lines.en: : Since when do I need a reason to place myself where all of the incest is happening?
lines.zh: : 从什么时候起,我需要一个理由才能把自己放到所有乱伦正在发生的地方?

lines.en: : Okay! Time for another commercial-
lines.zh: : 好的!又到了广告时间——

lines.en: : Karin, stop! They haven’t paid us enough for all these time slots!
lines.zh: : Karin,停!他们给的钱可不够买这么多广告时段!

lines.en: : She’s been following me around ever since the poetry thing, Sensei! It’s starting to creep me out!
lines.zh: : 从诗歌那件事之后她就一直跟着我,Sensei!我开始觉得毛骨悚然了!

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent9
: Nodoka, I understand that you may have given up Wakana in exchange for her cooperation in...getting Noriko to hug me. But there are more suitable replacements for her than Ami.
lines.zh: : Nodoka,我理解你可能为了让 Wakana 配合……让 Noriko 抱我,而把她让出去了。但比 Ami 更合适的替代人选多得是。

lines.en: : Like who?
lines.zh: : 比如谁?

lines.en: : Obviously Touka.
lines.zh: : 显然是 Touka。

lines.en: : Um, hello? I am right here. Please do not volunteer me to be stalked.
lines.zh: : 呃,喂?我就在这儿。请不要主动把我推去被人跟踪。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent10
: I suppose that just leaves Uta then...
lines.zh: : 那看来就只剩 Uta 了……

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : And Karin.
lines.zh: : 还有 Karin。

lines.en: : Shh...there are simply some things that should just never be corrupted, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嘘……有些东西是绝对不该被玷污的,Sensei。

lines.en: : Nodoka, why are you here? For real.
lines.zh: : Nodoka,你到底为什么在这儿?说真的。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent11

: Curiosity, of course. You see, I’ve been feeling a little...unmotivated ever since our vacation started. And I just happen to believe observing your beloved niece for a little while will help me get back on track.
lines.zh: : 当然是好奇。你看,自从我们的假期开始,我就一直觉得有点……提不起劲。而我恰好相信,观察你心爱的侄女一段时间,能帮我重新找回状态。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent12
: Do I love attention? Yes. But this is {i}not{/i} the kind of attention I want. This just makes me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢被人关注吗?喜欢。但这{i}不是{/i}我想要的那种关注。这只会让我觉得很别扭。

lines.en: : Well, there’s nothing I can do about it. This is clearly Nodoka’s world and we’re all just living in it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那我也无能为力。这显然是 Nodoka 的世界,我们都只是住在里面而已。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure that’s not gonna set off any alarms.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我敢肯定这绝对不会引起任何警觉。

lines.en: : The rules of the contest are simple, Sensei! And for the sake of keeping things brief, we’ve decided to allow each contestant {i}one{/i} motherly task of their choosing to complete.
lines.zh: : 比赛规则很简单,Sensei!为了简短起见,我们决定允许每位参赛者自选完成{i}一{/i}项母亲般的任务。

lines.en: : Their effectiveness in completing these tasks will obviously be determined by you! And after each one of them gets to go, you’ll be free to pick whoever was the most motherly!
lines.zh: : 她们完成这些任务的效果显然由你来判定!等她们各自完成之后,你就可以自由选出最有母性的那一个!

lines.en: : Also, any and all physical contact must be approved by the council of judges before taking place. We don’t want things getting {i}too{/i} crazy after all.
lines.zh: : 另外,任何肢体接触都必须先经过评审委员会批准才能进行。毕竟我们不想让事情变得{i}太{/i}失控。

lines.en: : Is the council of judges just you and Karin?
lines.zh: : 评审委员会就只有你和 Karin 吗?

lines.en: : And me.
lines.zh: : 还有我。

lines.en: : Nodoka is not a judge. The council {i}is{/i} just me and Karin.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 不是评委。委员会{i}就只有{/i}我和 Karin。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent13
: In that case, may I beseech the council for its approval in allowing physical contact between Sensei and me? The task of my choosing can not be completed without it.
lines.zh: : 既然如此,我可以恳请委员会批准我和 Sensei 之间的肢体接触吗?我选的任务没有它就完成不了。

lines.en: : {i}Touka{/i} is asking for physical contact permission?! But that’s a rule we made to deal with Ami!
lines.zh: : {i}Touka{/i} 居然申请肢体接触许可?!可那条规则是我们专门为了对付 Ami 定的啊!

lines.en: : Yeah! I’m the physical contact girl!
lines.zh: : 对啊!我才是肢体接触担当!

lines.en: : I wonder if breastfeeding {i}is{/i} being permitted after all...
lines.zh: : 我在想,哺乳是不是其实{i}被允许{/i}了……

lines.en: : Same here.
lines.zh: : 我也在想。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent14
: Don’t be a pig.
lines.zh: : 别这么下流。

lines.en: : Just so you know, I’d be really mad right now if I was {i}allowed{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚,如果{i}允许{/i}我生气的话,我现在真的会很生气。

lines.en: : Touka, um...just what sort of...physical contact are you looking to make?
lines.zh: : Touka,呃……你想要的到底是哪种……肢体接触?

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent15
: I was hoping I’d be permitted to help him bathe.
lines.zh: : 我希望能被允许帮他洗澡。

lines.en: : Hahah! As if {i}that’s{/i} an acceptable thing for a high schooler to be doing with her teacher! Hahaha! Hah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈!就好像一个女高中生跟她的老师做{i}这{/i}种事是能接受的似的!哈哈哈!哈!

lines.en: : Well, that wasn’t a suspicious reaction at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这反应一点都不可疑。

lines.en: : You...to...help him...b...what?
lines.zh: : 你……要……帮他……洗……什么?

lines.en: : That obviously isn’t going to be approved, Touka. Come up with something else or bow out now.
lines.zh: : 这显然不会通过,Touka。想点别的,不然现在就退出。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent16
: Are {i}all{/i} of your minds this inappropriate at all times? I’m not insinuating that we’d be in the nude. Sensei would be in a swimsuit. Or even fully clothed for all I care.
lines.zh: : 你们脑子是不是无时无刻{i}都{/i}这么龌龊?我可没暗示我们会光着身子。Sensei 会穿着泳衣。就算他穿得整整齐齐我也无所谓。

lines.en: : I’d prefer not to bathe fully clothed, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我还是不想穿着衣服洗澡,谢谢。

lines.en: : Shush, I’m talking to your second mother right now.
lines.zh: : 嘘,我现在正在跟你的第二个妈妈说话。

lines.en: : I wonder if this is how Rin feels at home...
lines.zh: : 我在想 Rin 在家里是不是也是这种感觉……

lines.en: : Ami, I would merely be washing his back. And you’d all be there to supervise it. If that is such a problem-
lines.zh: : Ami,我只是帮他搓个背而已。而且你们全都在场监督。如果这也有问题——

lines.en: : It is. Vetoed. No.
lines.zh: : 有问题。否决。不行。

lines.en: : That’s all?
lines.zh: : 就这样?

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent17
: Karin! You’re supposed to be on my team!
lines.zh: : Karin!你应该站在我这边的!

lines.en: : Of course that’s all. Do you really take me for the type of woman to make a move on a man in broad daylight, surrounded by others? I’ve yet to so much as {i}kiss{/i} a man. I’m quite far from {i}exhibitionism.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然就这样。你真把我想成那种会在光天化日、众目睽睽之下对男人出手的女人吗?我连一个男人都还没{i}亲过{/i}呢。我离{i}暴露癖{/i}远得很。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it’s a problem then. I mean, we’ll all be there to watch...won’t we? As long as it doesn’t get out of hand like last night’s modeling thing, I think it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得没什么问题。我是说,我们全都会在场看着……对吧?只要不像昨晚那场走秀一样失控,我觉得没问题。

lines.en: : I have no opinion on this matter as it has never even crossed my mind before. Haha.
lines.zh: : 这件事我没有意见,因为我以前压根就没想过。哈哈。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent18
: How do you feel about this, Sensei? Are you okay with Touka’s proposal?
lines.zh: : 你觉得怎么样,Sensei?你能接受 Touka 的提议吗?

lines.en: : I think a better question is if {i}Touka{/i} is okay with Touka’s proposal.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更好的问题是,{i}Touka{/i} 自己能不能接受 Touka 的提议。

lines.en: : Thank you for using my real name. But also, why would I not be okay with my own proposal? Assisting your child in the bath is a motherly thing to do, is it not?
lines.zh: : 谢谢你还用我的真名。不过话说回来,我为什么会不接受我自己的提议?帮你的孩子洗澡是很母亲的事,不是吗?

lines.en: : And if I can evoke memories of your childhood, the potential for me to come out on top of Ami becomes much greater than it would otherwise be {i}without{/i} doing that.
lines.zh: : 而且如果我能唤起你童年的回忆,我压过 Ami 登顶的可能性就会比{i}不{/i}这么做要大得多。

lines.en: : All in favor of increasing Touka’s chances to wind up on top of Ami, say aye.
lines.zh: : 所有赞成提高 Touka 压在 Ami 上面的几率的,说「赞成」。

lines.en: scene mombattlebutdifferent19
: Then it’s settled!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了!

lines.en: : Wha- I obviously wasn’t finished! There was more to that sentence!
lines.zh: : 什——我明显还没说完!那句话后面还有内容!

lines.en: : It appears our judges have heard all they’ve needed to hear. Now come, child. Mother will take good care of you.
lines.zh: : 看来评委们已经听够了他们需要听的。来吧,孩子。妈妈会好好照顾你的。

lines.en: scene black
: Please don’t call me “child.”
lines.zh: : 请别叫我「孩子」。

lines.en: : Would you prefer “my son?” Or “darling” perhaps?
lines.zh: : 那你更喜欢「我的儿子」?还是「亲爱的」?

lines.en: : None of the above!
lines.zh: : 都不要!

lines.en: : That last one is fine.
lines.zh: : 最后那个可以。

lines.en: : No it’s not! Now stop making the evil Ami come back out!
lines.zh: : 不,不可以!别再把邪恶的 Ami 给逼出来了!

lines.en: Somehow or another, the six of us wind up heading over to the baths so Touka can...rub my back and call me her son?
lines.zh: 不知道怎么搞的,我们六个人最后还是往澡堂去了,好让 Touka……给我搓背,还叫我儿子?

lines.en: It’s a very {i}Dorm Wars{/i} scenario but, at the same time, my life has devolved to the point where even things like {i}this{/i} seem pretty normal.
lines.zh: 这很像{i}宿舍战争{/i}里会出现的场面,但与此同时,我的人生已经堕落到了连{i}这种事{/i}都显得相当正常的地步。

lines.en: scene confessionbattle35
Well, when compared to things like this at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少跟这种事比起来是这样。

lines.en: : What happened to our conversatiooooooooon!!!!!

lines.en: : But what I do know is that, like me...you’re very exhausted by all of this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 但我确实知道的是,和我一样……你也被这一切弄得筋疲力尽了吧?

lines.en: : Did something happen? You can tell me about it, you know. Just do it quietly so none of our {i}spectators{/i} get jealous and interrupt us.

: You know, I’m not quite sure anymore. Because, while it may be the first time I am {i}intentionally{/i} slipping into this role, it’s far from the first time I’ve ever felt the...maternal urge to care for you.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我自己也不太确定了。因为,虽然这可能是我第一次{i}有意识地{/i}进入这个角色,但我想照顾你的……母性冲动,可远不是第一次了。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s just because of my upbringing and how well {i}I’ve{/i} been cared for throughout my life...but you really do seem helpless sometimes.
lines.zh: : 也许只是因为我的成长环境,以及{i}我{/i}这辈子一直被照顾得很好……但你有时候真的看起来很无助。
